name: research
description: Skills that read X and the web: research-x summarizes update announcements from a list of X accounts (through the xAI API's X search) and posts one Slack message per announcement; read-x-article reads one X post or X Article from its URL through the fxtwitter API, summarizes it, and saves it as Markdown only when asked

accounts.title: X accounts to watch
accounts.description: Comma-separated X handles without @ (for example vendor_a,vendor_b). research-x asks about 10 of them per xAI request

slack_channel.title: Slack channel ID
slack_channel.description: ID of the channel research-x posts to and reads its history from (for example C0123456789, not the #name). Its history is research-x's only state. Required to post; a dry run without it doesn't skip what was already posted

summary_language.title: Summary language
summary_language.description: Language of the summaries (for example English or Japanese). Empty means the language you write to Claude in; a run outside Claude uses English

tone.title: Summary tone
tone.description: Free text describing the tone of the summaries. Empty means neutral and factual

topic_filter.title: What counts as an announcement
topic_filter.description: Free text telling the model which posts to keep. Empty means: new or changed application features only, no research results, only clear update announcements

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone for the times in the prompt and the report (for example Europe/Berlin). Empty means the system's local timezone

model.title: xAI model
model.description: xAI model to use. Empty means the newest plain grok-<version> in the xAI model list, picked on every run

save_dir.title: Folder read-x-article saves to
save_dir.description: Folder where read-x-article writes a Markdown copy of a post when you ask it to save (for example ~/notes/x). Empty means it never saves. If the folder has an INDEX.md, a line is added to it
